reason: The claim gets the hook's name wrong: useTraceItemAttributeKeys is not new and already has a spec (useTraceItemAttributeKeys.spec.tsx). The hook this patch adds is useGetTraceItemAttributeKeys (static/app/views/explore/hooks/useGetTraceItemAttributeKeys.tsx:55), and it has no useGetTraceItemAttributeKeys.spec.tsx. Its queryString→substringMatch path (lines 46, 65-71) is never tested, because the existing spec only reaches it through useTraceItemAttributeKeys, which calls getTraceItemAttributeKeys() with no argument (useTraceItemAttributeKeys.tsx queryFn).
